templates.title: 6. 請假安排（中文）
templates.body:
請假安排

為確保所有同學及老師，如同學需要更改上課時間或課堂，*請於上課時間前一日的營業時間內通知本中心，並得到本中心確認* 請假的課堂會以 *補堂形式* 處理, 所有課堂不接受任何原因順延。 如少於二十四小時前通知或即日取消課堂會扣堂,即日請假需要提供醫生紙‼️

補堂形式
約過老師另一日
於其後課堂加時補堂

除農曆初一,二,三外,所有公眾假期照常營業

二人班，如果一人請假另外一人繼續上堂，將不設補堂

3 至 6 人班請假不設補堂喔

最終決定權仍以本中心決定為準。

templates.title: 6b. Leave policy (English)
templates.body:
Important notes

We operate normally during public holidays (Except for the first, second and third day of the Chinese Lunar New Year Holiday). Student must notify the center for leave permit at least one day in advanced during business hours. No make-up classes will be available for ad-hoc leave. (Except for those with doctor’s note).

All classes that ask for leave will be arranged in the form of make-up lessons
Either arranging makeup lessons on alternate days
Or extension of classes

We operate normally during public holidays (Except for the first, second and third day of the Chinese Lunar New Year Holiday).

group of 2 : if student A takes leave and student B continues to attend class, there will be no make-up class
group of 3-6 : no make-up class

templates.title: 7. 解釋按月收費
templates.body: 因為我哋係按月收費，視乎返個個月有幾多個星期而去收費，四個星期就會收取四堂，五個星期就會收取五堂。因為公司電腦都已經自動 set 好左堂數，所以我哋都冇辦法去刪除或者改動任何堂數，希望家長可以明白
